page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 8 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, backed by 35 MB of L3 cache. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and operates on a KVM hypervisor with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate that the ecs.se1ne.2xlarge delivers modest compute performance. Single-core and multi-core CPU tests, such as stress-ng and Geekbench, place the instance in the bottom 25% and bottom 10% respectively. Memory bandwidth performance varies, with small-block cached reads scoring in the bottom 25%, while large-block uncached reads and writes achieve average tier performance. Cryptographic and database operations also trend toward the lower performance quartiles.

Given its high memory density of 64.0 GB relative to its 8 vCPUs, this instance offers a memory-optimized hardware profile. However, the tradeoff is its lower-tier compute and memory bandwidth performance. It is best suited for memory-intensive workloads that do not require high CPU throughput, such as caching layers, lightweight database operations, or memory-bound utility tasks where raw processing speed is not the primary bottleneck.
